acceptance: A run dir whose reports are under the threshold but whose logs and prompts are over it does not fire the trigger (red test first)
The threshold is chosen from a replay of real run dirs, recorded in the spec
fix: TDD first. Measure only the report artifacts that context-condense condenses (the phase reports and handoffs that the next phase reads), not logs, prompts or event streams; or re-key the trigger to a field that measures them. Replay the real run dirs of cycles 2020-2027 to pick the threshold. 100% coverage, zero comments, update internal-router.md and the phase spec.
routed_reason: operator 2026-10-27: lane-safe item; the evo loop builds the Todo work (curator reroute proposal, no protected surface, no pipeline kind)
summary: Filed from the independent review of PR #1105 (M2, 2026-10-21). router.runDirArtifactBytes sums every regular file in the workspace: logs, *-prompt.txt, *-events.ndjson and sandbox profiles. Real run dirs are 1.6 to 2.9 MB (cycle-2020..2027); after triage, advisor-prompt-plan.txt (44 KB), triage-events.ndjson (43 KB) and triage-prompt.txt (41 KB) alone pass 102400. So context-condense's insert trigger run_dir.artifact_bytes > 102400 is true on every cycle and its gate decides nothing.
title: context-condense: run_dir.artifact_bytes counts every file of the run dir, so its 100 KB trigger is always true
